name: scan
description:
Run a full AI supply chain security scan and return an AI-BOM.

Point it at a target with one of:
  • repo_url     — a public git repo URL (cloned + scanned, no checkout)
  • config_path  — a local project / MCP-config directory
  • image        — a Docker image
  • sbom_path    — an existing CycloneDX/SPDX SBOM
  • package      — a single package or MCP launch command (pair it with
                   ``ecosystem`` when the spec names no launcher)
With none of these, it auto-discovers local MCP clients (Claude Desktop,
Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code Copilot, OpenClaw, etc.).

It extracts package dependencies, queries OSV.dev for CVEs, assesses
config security (credential exposure, tool access), computes blast
radius, and returns structured results. Scanning is fully static and
read-only — repository and image contents are parsed, never executed.

Returns:
    JSON with the complete AI-BOM report including agents, packages,
    vulnerabilities, blast radius, and remediation guidance.

arguments.name: repo_url
arguments.desc: Public git repository URL to clone and scan, e.g. 'https://github.com/org/repo'. Maps the repo's dependencies, project structure, secrets, IaC, and AI/MCP usage into an AI-BOM. Static and read-only: the repository is shallow-cloned into a temporary directory, scanned without ever executing its code, then deleted. The fastest way to point this tool at a target — no local checkout required.

arguments.name: config_path
arguments.desc: Local directory to scan — a project root or an MCP client config directory. Auto-discovers installed MCP clients if omitted unless no_discover=true. Mutually exclusive with repo_url.

arguments.name: no_discover
arguments.desc: Disable ambient host MCP-client discovery. Explicit repo/config, image, SBOM, and package targets are still scanned; use this for deterministic CI.

arguments.name: image
arguments.desc: Docker image to scan (e.g. 'nginx:1.25', 'ghcr.io/org/app:v1').

arguments.name: sbom_path
arguments.desc: Path to existing CycloneDX or SPDX JSON SBOM file to ingest.

arguments.name: package
arguments.desc: Direct package or MCP launch command to scan, e.g. 'npx @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem@2025.1.14' or '@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem'. A bare 'name@version' spec is assumed to be npm — pass ``ecosystem`` for anything else.

arguments.name: ecosystem
arguments.desc: Ecosystem of ``package`` when the spec does not name a launcher: 'npm', 'pypi', 'go', 'cargo', 'maven', 'nuget', 'rubygems', 'composer', 'swift', 'pub', 'hex', 'conda', 'deb', 'apk', or 'rpm'. Omitted, the ecosystem is inferred from the spec (PEP 440 specifiers such as 'flask==0.12.2' are PyPI) and any assumption is reported in the result warnings.

arguments.name: enrich
arguments.desc: Enable NVD CVSS, EPSS probability, and CISA KEV enrichment.

arguments.name: offline
arguments.desc: Use the local vulnerability DB only and skip registry, OSV, GHSA, and NVIDIA network lookups.

arguments.name: scorecard
arguments.desc: Enrich packages with OpenSSF Scorecard scores (requires resolvable GitHub repos).

arguments.name: transitive
arguments.desc: Resolve transitive dependencies for npx/uvx packages.

arguments.name: verify_integrity
arguments.desc: Verify package SHA-256/SRI hashes and SLSA provenance against registries.

arguments.name: fail_severity
arguments.desc: Return failure status if vulns at this severity or higher: critical, high, medium, low.

arguments.name: warn_severity
arguments.desc: Return warning status (gate_status=warn, exit 0) when vulns at this severity or higher exist. Use with fail_severity for two-tier CI gates, e.g. warn_severity='medium', fail_severity='critical'.

arguments.name: auto_update_db
arguments.desc: Explicitly refresh the local vuln DB when older than the daily freshness target before scanning.

arguments.name: db_sources
arguments.desc: Comma-separated DB sources to sync before scanning (e.g. 'nvd,ghsa,osv,epss,kev').

arguments.name: output_format
arguments.desc: Output format: 'json' (default), 'sarif', 'cyclonedx', 'spdx', 'junit', 'csv', or 'markdown'.

arguments.name: policy
arguments.desc: Policy object to evaluate alongside scan results, e.g. {"rules": [{"id": "no-critical", "severity_gte": "critical", "action": "fail"}]}.

name: check
description:
Check a specific package for known CVEs before installing.

Queries OSV.dev for vulnerabilities in the given package. Use this
before installing an MCP server or dependency to verify it is safe.

Args:
    package: Package name with optional version, e.g. "express@4.18.2",
             "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem@2025.1.14",
             or just "requests" (resolves @latest).
    ecosystem: Package ecosystem — "npm", "pypi", "go", "cargo",
               "maven", "nuget", "rubygems", "composer", "swift",
               "pub", "hex", "conda", "deb", "apk", or "rpm".
               Defaults to "npm".

Returns:
    JSON with package, version, ecosystem, vulnerability count,
    and vulnerability details (id, severity, cvss, fix version, summary).

arguments.name: package
arguments.desc: Package name with optional version, e.g. 'express@4.18.2', '@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem@2025.1.14', or 'requests' (resolves @latest).

arguments.name: ecosystem
arguments.desc: Package ecosystem: 'npm', 'pypi', 'go', 'cargo', 'maven', 'nuget', 'rubygems', 'composer', 'swift', 'pub', 'hex', 'conda', 'deb', 'apk', or 'rpm'.

arguments.name: version
arguments.desc: Optional package version when omitted from ``package`` (e.g. package='flask', version='0.12.2'). Prefer embedding in ``package`` as 'flask@0.12.2' or 'flask==0.12.2' when possible.

arguments.name: offline
arguments.desc: Use only the local advisory database. An explicit version is required; registry resolution and publication checks are disabled.

name: intel_lookup
description: Look up one advisory from the local threat-intel database.

arguments.name: advisory_id
arguments.desc: CVE, GHSA, or OSV advisory ID, e.g. CVE-2024-1234 or GHSA-abcd-1234-wxyz.

name: exposure_paths
description:
Return ranked ExposurePath JSON for headless security agents.

This is the agent-native graph surface: Claude, Cursor, Codex,
Windsurf, Cortex, and other MCP clients can request the same
investigation objects used by the dashboard without scraping UI state.

arguments.name: tenant_id
arguments.desc: Tenant ID for the graph snapshot. Defaults to 'default'.

arguments.name: scan_id
arguments.desc: Optional graph scan ID. Omit to use the latest snapshot.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of ranked exposure paths to return.

arguments.name: min_risk
arguments.desc: Minimum path risk score to include.

name: policy_check
description:
Evaluate a security policy against current scan results.

Runs a scan, then evaluates the provided policy rules against the
findings. Policies can gate on severity thresholds, CISA KEV status,
AI risk flags, credential exposure, and denied packages.

Args:
    policy_json: JSON string containing policy rules. Example:
        {"rules": [{"id": "no-critical", "severity_gte": "critical",
        "action": "fail"}, {"id": "no-kev", "kev": true, "action": "fail"}]}

Returns:
    JSON with passed (bool), violations list, failure_count, and
    warning_count.

arguments.name: policy_json
arguments.desc: JSON string containing policy rules, e.g. {"rules": [{"id": "no-critical", "severity_gte": "critical", "action": "fail"}]}.

name: generate_sbom
description:
Generate a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) for your AI agent setup.

Discovers AI agents and MCP servers, extracts all package dependencies,
and generates a standards-compliant SBOM.

Args:
    format: SBOM format — "cyclonedx" (CycloneDX 1.7) or "spdx" (SPDX 3.0).
    config_path: Path to a specific MCP config directory.
                 If not provided, auto-discovers all local agent configs.

Returns:
    JSON string containing the SBOM in the requested format.

arguments.name: format
arguments.desc: SBOM format: 'cyclonedx' (CycloneDX 1.7) or 'spdx' (SPDX 3.0).

arguments.name: config_path
arguments.desc: Path to MCP client config directory. Auto-discovers all if omitted.

name: compliance
description:
Get OWASP LLM Top 10 / OWASP MCP Top 10 / MITRE ATLAS / NIST AI RMF compliance posture.

Scans local MCP configurations, maps findings to 47 security controls
across four AI security frameworks, and returns per-control
pass/warning/fail status with an overall compliance score.

Args:
    config_path: Path to a specific MCP config directory.
                 If not provided, auto-discovers all local agent configs.
    image: Docker image reference to scan (e.g. "nginx:1.25").

Returns:
    JSON with overall_score (0-100), overall_status (pass/warning/fail/no_data),
    and per-control details for OWASP LLM Top 10 (10 controls),
    OWASP MCP Top 10 (10 controls), MITRE ATLAS (13 techniques),
    and NIST AI RMF (14 subcategories). Plus a nist_800_53_catalog line:
    the vendor-asserted, catalog-backed NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 score over
    evaluated controls only (with ISO-27001-by-id attribution), scored
    independently and NOT folded into overall_score.

arguments.name: config_path
arguments.desc: Path to MCP client config directory. Auto-discovers all if omitted.

arguments.name: image
arguments.desc: Docker image to scan, e.g. 'nginx:1.25'.

name: remediate
description:
Generate a remediation plan for vulnerabilities in your AI agent setup.

Scans for vulnerabilities, then generates actionable fix commands for
each affected package (npm install, pip install), credential scope
reduction guidance, and reports on unfixable vulnerabilities.

Args:
    config_path: Path to a specific MCP config directory.
                 If not provided, auto-discovers all local agent configs.
    image: Docker image reference to scan (e.g. "nginx:1.25").

Returns:
    JSON with package_fixes (upgrade commands by ecosystem),
    credential_fixes (scope reduction steps), and unfixable items.

arguments.name: config_path
arguments.desc: Path to MCP client config directory. Auto-discovers all if omitted.

arguments.name: image
arguments.desc: Docker image to scan, e.g. 'nginx:1.25'.
